t: Who Allah says His love has become due for
a: وَجَبَتْ مَحَبَّتِي لِلْمُتَحَابِّينَ فِيَّ وَالْمُتَجَالِسِينَ فِيَّ وَالْمُتَزَاوِرِينَ فِيَّ وَالْمُتَبَاذِلِينَ فِيَّ
p: Wajabat maḥabbatī li-l-mutaḥābbīna fiyya wa-l-mutajālisīna fiyya wa-l-mutazāwirīna fiyya wa-l-mutabādhilīna fiyya
m: My love has become due for those who love one another in Me, who sit together in Me, who visit one another in Me, and who spend on one another in Me.
